_comment: TERMINAL-ART-V2 runtime adaptation of commit 0fd8cad4c9ef639785eb22a0f01205928b9b65b4. Four supplied maps retained byte-identical. Source-only unneeded metallic/roughness maps omitted. Physical Earth display is unchanged.

metallicGlossMap.channels: metallic in RGB, smoothness in A (URP: smoothness source = metallic alpha)

MT_TerminalBody.covers: TerminalBody (enclosure, bezel, gasket, chamfer, controls, fasteners, mount, connectors, cable) and Left handhold

MT_Labels.covers: printed legends and plates on TerminalBody (second material slot); not emissive

MT_Screen.shader: replaced at runtime by the terminal display shader (TERM-V1)
MT_Screen.covers: ActiveDisplay: near-black matte cover glass when the display is off

MT_Amber.covers: Status lamp (same name and place as TERM-V1)
